ClassInstance.policies:
tenant_isolation|ALL|PERMISSIVE|{public}|USING(((current_setting('app.bypass_rls'::text, true) = 'on'::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM "Class"
  WHERE (("Class".id = "ClassInstance"."classId") AND ("Class"."tenantId" = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id'::text, true)))))))|CHECK()
